{{incomplete|needs=Catalogue numbers}} The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twelfth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, ''[[S12|Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles]]'', in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). ==Volume releases== {{incomplete|section|needs=Aspect ratios}} Four ''Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles'' DVD box sets were released in 2011 by [[VIZ Media]] and distributed through {{wp|Warner Home Video}}, containing the whole season between them. There are four boxed sets each containing two volumes with one disc each. The volumes were sold both individually and as part of the box sets. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs. ===Box Set 1: Episodes 1-15=== [[File:DP Galactic Battles Box 1 Cover.png|thumb|200px|Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles - Box Set 1]] Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles - Box Set 1 was released on March 15, 2011. It contains two discs with 15 episodes across them combined. The contained volumes were released for individual sale on the same day as the box set. {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Sinnoh}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Sinnoh}}; {{roundy|10px}}" ! ''[[DP157|Gotta Get a Gible!]]'' |} ==The Complete Season== [[File:Pokémon the Series DP Galactic Battles The Complete Season DVD.png|thumb|200px|right|Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles - The Complete Season]] Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles - The Complete Season, referred to as Pokémon The Series: Diamond and Pearl Galactic Battles Complete Season on VIZ Media's website, is a [[Complete Collection]] DVD set that was released on August 18, 2020 by [[VIZ Media]] and distributed through {{wp|Warner Home Video}}. This Complete Collection contains seven discs with 52 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000083356. It consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover. It includes episodes with a 4:3 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}} and episodes with a {{wp|16:9}} aspect ratio. {| class="roundtable" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Sinnoh}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Sinnoh}};" !
